# Bannerbite

Bannerbite is a creative automation platform for generating images and videos from reusable projects and templates.

Category: Design. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/bannerbite/.

## Actions

- **Generate Media**: Queue one asynchronous image, video, or overlay render from a Bannerbite bite.
- **Get Bite** (read-only): Return one Bannerbite bite by its numeric bite ID, including template and output-size details.
- **Get Project** (read-only): Return one Bannerbite project by its numeric project ID.
- **Get Scene Data** (read-only): Return the editable scene fields for a Bannerbite bite so their names and current values can be used in a render request.
- **List Bites** (read-only): Return one provider page of Bannerbite bites in a project, up to 100 bites.
- **List Projects** (read-only): Return one provider page of projects owned by the connected Bannerbite account, up to 100 projects.
